cover.alt: Wild Chemistry Issue 1 cover, with Robbie and Brenden against the Vancouver skyline.

pages.alt: Page 1: Robbie and Brenden meet at a government office and decide to spend time together.
Page 2: Robbie and Brenden get to know each other at Robbie’s home.
Page 3: Robbie introduces Brenden to his roommate Darcie.
Page 4: Darcie transforms into a monster as Robbie and Brenden react.
Page 5: Robbie and Brenden combine their magic in a battle.
Page 6: Robbie and Brenden discover their different powers.
Page 7: Robbie and Brenden reflect on their powers and their connection.
